answer: We propose a mechanism where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds require staking collateral proportional to identity entropy, creating a karst of economic friction that erodes illicit capital accumulation. Subgame-perfect slashing matrices enforce penalties exceeding the saffron value of sybil-weighted rewards, rendering the expected utility of identity multiplication strictly negative. A beacon of zero-knowledge verifiable delay ensures consensus, forcing adversaries into a Nash equilibrium where honest node cooperation maximizes marginal yield.
